label: Snug Interior
description: Small warm rooms built for staying in — the hygge end of architecture, domestic and human-scaled.

items.name: window-reading-nook
items.text: a deep bay-window reading nook, cushions worn to the shape of habit, a wool throw and a book left face-down mid-chapter

items.name: attic-eaves-bedroom
items.text: an attic bedroom tucked under sloping eaves, exposed beams close overhead, a skylight framing the weather above a thick quilt

items.name: log-cabin-corner
items.text: a log-cabin corner, notched timber walls glowing honey, enamel mugs on hooks and a ladder rising to a bunk under the ridge

items.name: farmhouse-range-kitchen
items.text: a farmhouse kitchen gathered around a cast-iron range, drying herbs overhead, a kettle sighing and worn flagstones underfoot

items.name: canal-boat-cabin
items.text: a narrowboat cabin lined in lacquered wood and painted roses, brass portholes, a tiny stove ticking with heat

items.name: library-armchair-corner
items.text: a library corner with one cracked leather armchair, shelves rising to the ceiling, a reading lamp pooling gold on the open page

items.name: ski-lodge-fireside
items.text: a ski-lodge fireside, a stone chimney breast, wet mittens steaming on the fender and a deep sofa turned toward the flames

items.name: garden-shed-studio
items.text: a garden shed turned tiny studio, paint-stained workbench, seed packets pinned to the wall and a small heater purring in the corner

items.name: vintage-caravan
items.text: a vintage caravan interior, curved birch ceiling, gingham curtains and a fold-down table laid for two

items.name: keepers-room
items.text: a lighthouse keeper's room, curved whitewashed walls, a brass barometer by the stair and one deep-set window onto the sea

items.name: stone-bothy
items.text: a one-room stone mountain bothy, sleeping platform against the gable, boots drying by the hearth and a visitors' book on the ledge

items.name: winter-conservatory
items.text: a small conservatory in winter, ferns pressing the glass from inside, a rattan chair and a folded blanket against the cold panes
